fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.q_en: Near the Peak, Flora buys 2 mooncakes at 7 yuan each and pays with 20 yuan. How much change does she get?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山附近，Flora 买了 2 块月饼，每块 7 元，付了 20 元，应找回多少元？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Along the harbour there are 3 trams, each with 5 passengers. How many passengers are there?
questions.q_zh: 维港边有 3 支叮叮车，每队有 5 名乘客，一共有多少名乘客？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the harbour, 54 festival lanterns are shared equally by 9 trams. How many does each team get?
questions.q_zh: 在维港，54 盏节日灯笼平均分给 9 支叮叮车，每队几面？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The Mid-Autumn evening by the harbour starts at 8:10 and ends at 8:30. How many minutes does it last?
questions.q_zh: 维港边的中秋赏月 8:10 开始，8:30 结束，一共多少分钟？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora sees 2 square-shaped tags on a tram by the harbour. How many sides do they have altogether?
questions.q_zh: Flora 在维港的叮叮车上看见 2 面正方形的旗子，它们一共有几条边？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The harbour had 332 festival visitors today. Round 332 to the nearest hundred.
questions.q_zh: 今天维港的节日游客有 332 人，把 332 四舍五入到百位。
questions.explain_en: 332 rounded to the nearest hundred is 300.
